Quotes / Paul Tillich / Q0489

Courage is the self-affirmation of being in spite of the fact of nonbeing.
Thinker Paul Tillich
School Existential Theology
Source The Courage to Be

Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with The Courage to Be, within the tradition of Existential Theology. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of courage, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Paul Tillich's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
